title: God’s promises don’t expire — they mature.
paragraphs:
God’s promises don’t expire — they mature.
Sometimes it feels like nothing is moving… but behind the scenes, God is aligning everything.
If He said it, He will do it. Delay is not denial — it’s development.
Hold on. Your promise is growing wings. 🕊️✨
“For the vision is yet for an appointed time… Though it tarries, wait for it; because it will surely come.” — Habakkuk 2:3
Your promise is not dead — it’s maturing.
